title: Certificates of Deposit: room in the savings or money market account funding a maximum in-term add-on
content:
## Scope

When the owner of a Certificates of Deposit certificate asks to move as much as the certificate will take into it as an in-term add-on from the owner's active PCB savings or money market account, this rule measures how much that account can supply.

## Rule

The room in the funding account is that savings or money market account's current balance, as it stands when the add-on is made, because a savings balance can never go below zero.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Reading | Output |
|---|---|---|
| The owner's active PCB savings or money market account | Its current balance in the bank's records at the moment of the add-on | Room in the funding account |

## Cases (hypothetical balances)

| Current balance of the owner's active savings or money market account | Room in the funding account |
|---|---|
| 12400.00 | 12400.00 |
| 318.27 | 318.27 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Can the transfer take the savings account into overdraft to cover a larger add-on?**
No. A savings balance can never go below zero, so the room is the current balance itself.

**Is the balance at the start of the month used?**
No. The current balance as it stands when the add-on is made is used.
